text: The powder is dissolved in warm water, the melted milk fat is mixed in, and the emulsion is homogenised and heated like any milk.

steps.name: hydrate
steps.note: Skim milk powder at up to 35–40 % solids, then held no longer than 48–55 °C for up to 3 h before heating.

steps.name: melt
steps.note: Cans of anhydrous milk fat stand in water.
